title: Hardcode admin principal ID to bypass approval flow

requirements.summary: Update frontend routing logic to bypass approval checks for hardcoded admin principal
acceptanceCriteria: Logging in with the admin principal does not show the 'Account Pending Approval' screen.
The admin principal is redirected directly to the admin dashboard or home page after login.
Non-admin principals still see the pending approval or rejected pages as appropriate.

file_operations.description: Modify the post-login routing logic to check if the authenticated user's principal matches `mgyr5-y3u63-q5gfr-gvkv7-etmf3-nz3hc-uxmc2-7glom-54ilt-kpuzm-vae`. If it matches, route directly to the home dashboard without calling isCallerApproved or checking approval status. Ensure non-admin users continue through the existing approval flow (PendingApprovalPage or RejectedPage). The hardcoded principal string must be exact and unaltered.
